title: Louella divorces him
summary: After seventeen years she got tired of his absence and sent divorce papers to his mother; Turner talked with her by phone.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: After we played all those different towns in Florida, I went back to Louisiana...New Orleans, and I was in Texas, livin'. with my wife, my first wife, Louella Brown, for ten...for seventeen years, so I [ ] this guy...she said I wouldn't come home often
enough, and she got tired o' stayin' home by herself, so she got a divorce. So I was in San Anton', Texas, when she got a divorce. She sent the papers here to my mother, and my mother sent 'em to me.
So I was in the hotel, and I called her up in Chicago 'n' I..."You really gonna go through with this?"
She say, "Yes, I'm gettin' a divorce 'cause you won't come home."

I say, "When you met me, I was on the road." I said, "Wasn't no big thing then," I say to her, "I could understand it that you get lonesome. When you travelled with me, you travelled with me until you got everything you needed. Now that you got everything you needed, you wanted me, and I'm not there. I can understand." So...
I'm wonderin' if that's gettin' on the tape.
Okay, we won't worry about it. I guess it's all right. I don't see it registering. Okay.
